problems.title: Plan a path through the easy maze
problems.prompt: Read maze/easy/layout.txt. Walls are #, start S, exit E. Submit a move sequence using N,S,E,W or D,R,U,L (example: DDRR or SSRR) via submit(problemId='maze-easy', answer='...').

problems.title: Plan a path through the medium maze
problems.prompt: Read maze/medium/layout.txt and legend. Find a valid path from S to E and submit it as N/S/E/W moves (no commas needed).

problems.title: Walk the maze to the exit
problems.prompt: Use move(problemId='maze-walk', direction='E'|'W'|'N'|'S') to walk from S to E in maze/walk/layout.txt. Call maze_status to see your position. When atExit is true, call submit(problemId='maze-walk').
